Howard L. Beck (76)
Toronto, Ontario
Canada
column_3:
Mr. Beck is a corporate
director. Mr. Beck was a senior partner of the law firm, Davies, Ward &
Beck from 1962 to 1989. Mr. Beck holds an undergraduate degree and law degree
from the University of British Columbia and a master’s degree in law from
Columbia University. He was called to the bar of British Columbia and
Ontario. He was appointed Queen’s Counsel in 1971.Mr. Beck is also a director
of Citibank Canada. At different times during the period from 2005 to 2009,
Mr. Beck also served as a director or trustee of the following
publicly-traded entities: Cineplex Entertainment Corporation and Cineplex
Galaxy Income Fund.
Barrick Board Details:
· Director since 1984

column_1:
C. William D. Birchall (67)
Toronto, Ontario
Canada
column_3:
Mr. Birchall was appointed
as the Vice Chairman of Barrick in July 2005. From 2004 to March 2007, Mr.
Birchall was the Chief Executive Officer of ABX Financeco Inc., a Barrick
subsidiary. Mr. Birchall was the Vice Chairman of TrizecHahn Corporation, a
real estate company, from 1996 to 2006. He graduated from Merchant Taylor’s
School and is a Fellow of the United Kingdom Institute of Chartered
Accountants. Mr. Birchall is also a director of Rogers Communications Inc.
Mr. Birchall did not serve as a director of any other publicly-traded
companies during the period from 2005 to 2009.
Barrick Board Details:
· Vice Chairman since 2005
and Director since 1984
